item.title: FDA Pilots AI-Informed Facility Inspections
item.description:
• Summary: The FDA has launched a pilot program using artificial intelligence to conduct one-day facility inspections, aiming to increase efficiency and modernize regulatory oversight. The initiative could reduce the burden on manufacturers and improve detection of compliance issues.

  • Sources: BioSpace

item.title: Biotech Job Market and R&D Postings
item.description:
• Summary: The first quarter of 2026 saw a pickup in biotech job postings as the quarter progressed, driven by increased capital availability boosting R&D employment. The rebound reflects growing investor confidence and expansion of early-stage research activities across the sector.

item.title: FDA Rebuilding and Political Interference
item.description:
• Summary: The FDA is undergoing rebuilding efforts following the 'doge' era, with former regulators speaking out about the agency's challenges. The top three roles at FDA and CDC have been filled by 15 different people in less than 18 months, indicating a period of instability and turnover that has raised concerns about regulatory continuity and political interference.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News, BioSpace
